architecture_summary: Single-page React app. Static build. Dark-orange luxury theme. Tailwind CSS for styling. No backend. Pages: Hero landing, About marquee, Services & Projects showcase, Explore section, Collection footer. Navigation shell wire all pages.

tickets.title: Hero landing page (src/pages/Home.jsx)
tickets.description: Build hero landing. Dark-orange luxury theme. Hero text: 'Sugidev'. Subtitle: 'Luxury Digital Craftsmanship'. CTA button: 'Explore Work'. Background: subtle gradient overlay. Responsive typography.
acceptance_criteria: CTA button click scroll to next section

tickets.title: About marquee component (src/components/AboutMarquee.jsx)
tickets.description: Build marquee. Dark-orange luxury theme. Infinite horizontal scroll. Text: 'About Sugidev • Luxury Digital Craftsmanship •'. Smooth animation. Pause on hover.

tickets.title: Services & Projects showcase (src/pages/Showcase.jsx)
tickets.description: Build services & projects showcase. Dark-orange luxury theme. Grid layout. Services section: 3 cards (Web Design, Branding, Development). Projects section: 4 cards with hover effects. Title: 'Our Services & Projects'.

tickets.title: Explore section (src/pages/Explore.jsx)
tickets.description: Build explore section. Dark-orange luxury theme. Title: 'Explore More'. Subtitle: 'Discover our creative universe'. Background image overlay. CTA button: 'View All Projects'.
acceptance_criteria: CTA button click navigate to projects

tickets.title: Collection footer (src/components/Footer.jsx)
tickets.description: Build collection footer. Dark-orange luxury theme. 3 columns: 'Quick Links', 'Social Media', 'Newsletter'. Copyright text. Subtle gradient border top.

tickets.title: Global theme & assets (src/styles/theme.css, src/assets/)
tickets.description: Set global dark-orange luxury theme. Define CSS variables for colors, fonts, spacing. Import fonts (Playfair Display, Inter). Add favicon. Optimize assets.

tickets.title: App shell and navigation wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Wire all pages & components. Set up React Router. Dark-orange luxury theme. Smooth scroll between sections. Lazy load pages. Error boundary for 404.
